mentions.name: Open-source edge iNaturalist rebuild
mentions.description: An open-source rebuild of iNaturalist that uses open-weight models capable of running on edge compute for species/nature observation, aiming for better privacy and hopefully improved accuracy.
mentions.problem: Better privacy (and hopefully accuracy) compared to the existing service, by running open-weight models on edge compute.
mentions.source_excerpt: Rebuilding iNaturalist with open source/weights models that can run on edge compute for better privacy, and hopefully accuracy.
